sourceDescription: Mulligan's Pub is a Hoboken neighborhood institution where football fans of all kinds gather around big screens for proper pints, hearty pub fare including sirloin burgers, wings, and a full Irish breakfast served all day, plus pool and darts when the match is over. The place carries a warm, lived-in character rooted in Irish hospitality, drawing regulars who come as much for the camaraderie and the best draft Guinness in the area as for the sport. It's the kind of local you actually want to settle into, whether you're catching a Champions League fixture or an NFL Sunday.
